title: Production AI Systems — 3-Week Program
capstone: SecureDesk: a multi-tenant cloud AI assistant (AWS) for small firms with sensitive data. RAG over each firm's documents, a few agent workflows, strict tenant isolation.

weeks.title: Cloud infrastructure
weeks.goal: Architecture diagram v1 + 2 interview drills by day 14

weeks.title: Agentic patterns and securing them
weeks.goal: SecureDesk design doc v1 + mock interview by day 21

days.learn: What "production" means: availability, security, observability, operability, cost
days.decide: List 5 ways SecureDesk could fail its customers
days.resource: Google SRE book, ch. 1 (free online)

days.learn: Actors, data classification, trust boundaries
days.decide: Sketch a context diagram: firm staff, tenant admins, your ops team, the cloud provider, the internet. Mark every trust boundary
days.resource: OWASP Threat Modeling Cheat Sheet

days.learn: STRIDE threat modelling
days.decide: One threat per STRIDE letter against your diagram
days.resource: Microsoft STRIDE overview; Adam Shostack, Threat Modeling (book, optional)

days.learn: Authentication vs authorisation, least privilege, RBAC, MFA, SSO (OIDC/SAML)
days.decide: How does each firm's staff log in? Per-tenant SSO with their Microsoft or Google accounts, or your own logins?
days.resource: OWASP Authentication and Authorization Cheat Sheets

days.learn: Encryption at rest and in transit, TLS, key management services (KMS), envelope encryption
days.decide: One encryption key per tenant, or one for everyone? What does each buy you?
days.resource: AWS KMS concepts page; Cloudflare Learning Center: TLS

days.learn: Zero trust, network segmentation, least-privilege service access
days.decide: Which components must be reachable from the internet? Default answer: only the load balancer
days.resource: NIST SP 800-207 (Zero Trust Architecture), intro only

days.learn: Review / bus day
days.decide: Write Threat Model v1: one page, top 5 threats ranked, a mitigation for each
days.resource: Optional deep dive: AWS Well-Architected Security Pillar; UK NCSC Cyber Essentials requirements

days.learn: Cloud basics: regions, availability zones, the shared responsibility model, IAM roles vs users
days.decide: Which region, and why? UK legal and health data usually means a UK or EU region. Single AZ or multi-AZ?
days.resource: AWS Shared Responsibility Model page; AWS Well-Architected Framework, the 6 pillars

days.learn: Networking: VPCs, public vs private subnets, NAT, security groups, load balancers
days.decide: Draw the VPC. What sits in public subnets, what in private?
days.resource: AWS VPC docs, "How Amazon VPC works"

days.learn: Compute: containers on a managed service (ECS/Fargate) vs Kubernetes (EKS) vs serverless (Lambda). Model hosting: a provider API (e.g. Bedrock) vs self-hosted GPUs
days.decide: Write ADR-001: where the app runs, and where the model runs. Sensitive data makes the model choice a security decision too
days.resource: The Twelve-Factor App (12factor.net)

days.learn: Data and multi-tenancy: managed Postgres, object storage, vector search (e.g. pgvector), caching. Tenant isolation models: silo, pool, bridge
days.decide: Which isolation model for SecureDesk, and what enforces it: the database, the app, or both?
days.resource: AWS whitepaper on SaaS tenant isolation strategies

days.learn: Delivery: infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD, image signing, supply chain (SBOMs)
days.decide: How does a change get from a commit to production, and who must approve it?
days.resource: Terraform "What is Terraform" intro; SLSA framework overview

days.learn: Operations: logs, metrics, traces, audit logs, SLOs, backups, RPO/RTO
days.decide: One availability zone goes down at 10am. What happens to users, and what data could be lost?
days.resource: Google SRE book, "Monitoring Distributed Systems" and "Service Level Objectives" chapters

days.learn: Review / bus day
days.decide: Architecture diagram v1, plus 2 interview drills: URL shortener and rate limiter
days.resource: Alex Xu, System Design Interview vol. 1 (book), or ByteByteGo's free articles on both

days.learn: Workflows vs agents: prompt chaining, routing, parallelisation, orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimiser
days.decide: Which of SecureDesk's features need an agent, and which are a fixed workflow? Default to workflow
days.resource: Anthropic, "Building effective agents"

days.learn: RAG architecture: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector store, retrieval
days.decide: Permission-aware retrieval: how do you guarantee one tenant's documents never appear in another's results, and a junior never sees a file they can't open?
days.resource: Pinecone or Weaviate RAG primer (either)

days.learn: Tool use and MCP: tool design, scoped permissions, sandboxing
days.decide: Which tools does the agent get? Read-only vs write? What runs in a sandbox?
days.resource: Model Context Protocol docs: Introduction, Security best practices

days.learn: Agent security: prompt injection, the "lethal trifecta" (private data + untrusted content + a way to send data out)
days.decide: Which leg of the trifecta does SecureDesk remove, and how?
days.resource: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications; Simon Willison's blog posts on the lethal trifecta

days.learn: Evals and guardrails: test sets, regression evals, LLM-as-judge, human approval for actions
days.decide: Which agent actions need a human click before they run? How do you know a deploy didn't make answers worse?
days.resource: Hamel Husain's blog posts on LLM evals

days.learn: State, memory, and cost: context limits, conversation storage, caching, per-tenant token budgets
days.decide: Conversation logs are sensitive data. Where are they stored, for how long, who can read them? How do you stop one tenant running up the bill?
days.resource: NIST AI Risk Management Framework, overview

days.learn: Capstone / bus day
days.decide: Assemble SecureDesk design doc v1 (2 pages). Then a 45-minute mock interview with Claude: "Design a multi-tenant AI assistant for law firms"
days.resource: Your own notes from days 1–20
